meta.title: Refactor CSV line splitter
meta.body_summary: Refactor CSV line splitting to avoid Regex by implementing manual character-by-character parsing, claiming improved performance.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex replaced Regex CSV splitter with manual char loop; Gemini bot flagged edge cases, but maintainer merged citing existing tests pass and no previous invalid CSV handling.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 140 changed lines in a single file, this is a small refactor by absolute volume. It fits a small-step performance optimization that was merged despite bot CHANGES_REQUESTED, as maintainer dismissed correctness concerns.

review_details.concern_detail: Gemini bot flagged that manual parser may mishandle characters after closing quotes and unterminated quoted fields, and noted IsUnterminatedQuotedValue still uses Regex; maintainer dismissed concerns because existing tests pass and invalid CSV was not handled previously.
review_details.performance_claim: Avoid Regex for splitting CSV lines to improve performance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent produced a manual CSV parser that passes existing tests, but a code review bot flagged potential edge-case correctness issues; maintainer overrode concerns, suggesting agent can deliver working code that may not cover all spec compliance.

detection_detail.code_reading: Gemini bot performed static analysis and flagged correctness issues; maintainer acknowledged but dismissed citing existing test pass and no previous invalid CSV handling.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling data; only narrative claim of avoiding regex, but existing test suite passes.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Despite CHANGES_REQUESTED, maintainer merged without addressing flagged edge cases, stating existing tests pass and invalid CSV was not handled before.

core_change_summary.description: In Csv/CsvLineSplitter.cs, replaced Regex-based field splitting with a manual character-by-character loop that handles quotes, separators, and escape sequences using Span<char> or string slicing.
change_trajectory: Single commit refactored Split method to manual parsing; no iterative changes.

review_signals.summary: Initial formal review provided a summary of the change and a haiku, not blocking.
Detailed CHANGES_REQUESTED review flagged correctness issues (characters after quotes, unterminated fields), partial Regex usage, and lack of comments in manual parsing loop.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer dismissed concerns and merged without addressing them.

review_signals.summary: Characters after closing quote before separator are incorrectly included in field; high priority.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer replied that tests pass and invalid CSV was not handled before.

review_signals.summary: Unterminated quoted field produces incorrect last value; should error or handle as multi‑line.
IsUnterminatedQuotedValue still uses Regex, contradicting PR goal; interaction with new Split needs verification.
Manual parsing loop lacks comments, making it hard to understand and maintain.
Responded that tests still succeed and invalid CSV was not handled previously.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with single commit refactoring CSV splitter.
Gemini bot posted summary and then detailed CHANGES_REQUESTED within minutes.
Maintainer added an inline comment dismissing edge‑case concerns, citing existing test pass.
Maintainer merged ~4.8 hours later without addressing bot's changes requested.
